question:
The pie chart given below shows the production of 6 different factories. The total production of all these 6 factories is 15000. The production of a particular factory is shown as a percent of total production of all these 6 factories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac3432bf78feb4391f99353425e7a98fc0150bb125ae9dd0ae78d5757c4d0052.png] 

J1 = The value of average production of factories F3 and F6.

J2 = The difference between the production of factory F1 and F4.

What is the value of (J2 - J1)?
